title: SaveMyDiskToolSet
description: Universal Tool & Function Calling definitions for AI Agents (WorkBuddy, Cursor, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain, etc.)

function.name: audit_drives
function.description: Performs non-invasive read-only scan of fixed disk volumes, system hotspots ($WINDOWS.~BT, SoftwareDistribution, Docker vhdx), and top AppData directories. Outputs structured JSON.

json.description: Return structured JSON output instead of console text.

function.name: scan_app_residues
function.description: Scans for uninstalled Steam game leftover directories, empty/corrupt software directories, NVIDIA driver OTA caches, and safe-to-clean office/chat caches (WPS, WeChat, QQ, Feishu, DingTalk). Generates .save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md.

function.name: clean_selected_residues
function.description: Safely cleans confirmed residue IDs or reads approved checkboxes from the manifest file. Requires explicit user confirmation. Runs in dry-run mode unless force is true.

target_ids.description: List of residue IDs to clean (e.g. ["RES-001", "RES-002"]).

from_manifest.description: Read approved '- [x]' items directly from cleanup_manifest.md.

force.description: Must be set to true to execute actual deletion after user confirmation.

function.name: clean_windows_update
function.description: Safely purges Windows Update download cache and obsolete backups. Must be run with Administrator privileges after user confirmation.

function.name: verify_health
function.description: Verifies post-cleanup volume free space and Windows Update service operational health.
